dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that reminds Paimon! The moment we arrived in Snezhnaya, we were practically blown away by a massive blizzard... Ugh, Paimon really thought this place was terrifying at first...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of the Snegurochka's Demesne

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This doll... Oh, this is what Ikor transformed into! The one from that manor crawling with Snegoviks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we hadn't been able to stop Pavlina, what would have happened to everything...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of the Firebird Gulch

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seeing this just makes Paimon think of Nastya... Paimon still doesn't understand why she refused to come out with us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that she's ended up like that... do you think she still feels lonely?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of the Belyi Tsar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...This locomotive... Wait, did you say you've seen it before back at the Alypium?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that makes sense! Maybe the prototype of this train might have originated from that very place...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the train and the passing scenery

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Every time we're on the train, Paimon loves watching the mountains and ice fields whiz past the window!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right... There's something Paimon's been wanting to do for ages. First, we need to huff a little air onto the glass...
